statement: TC Research Epic: Support Geometry, Actual Approximation, and Complete-Sign Certification: (1) Rescaling Retraction & Scoped Divergence: The prior universal norm-divergence claim (asserting that every legal sequence with h -> 0 has diverging H^1 norm) is definitively refuted and withdrawn by the coefficient rescaling counterexample f_h = h * g_h / ||g_h||_{H^1}, which satisfies ||f_h||_{H^1} = h -> 0 while preserving legal family membership by coefficient homogeneity; individual bump H^1 norm scaling ||psi_h||_{H^1} ~ 127.466 * h^{-7/2} is retained and extends to linear combinations under a uniform coefficient lower bound ||c||_2 >= c_0 > 0 without exact derivative cancellation; however, ||f_h||_{H^1} -> 0 approximates the zero function and cannot approximate any non-zero target f_* (formally proved in Lean 4: coefficient_rescaling_norm_scaling). (2) Fixed-Span vs Varying-Family Distinction: A fixed finite configuration at fixed bandwidth has a finite-dimensional span of dimension M, but the union over varying configurations, grade counts, windows, and bandwidths is infinite-dimensional; claims closing the approximation scheme merely by finite dimensionality of individual spans are withdrawn. (3) Genuine Support-Component Poincaré Obstruction: If a smooth function f is supported in a finite union of connected components of length at most ell and vanishes at their boundaries, then ||f||_{L^2} <= ell * ||f'||_{L^2}; for any target function f_* with H^1 distance eps = ||f - f_*||_{H^1}, the triangle inequality forces the amplitude-independent quantitative lower bound eps >= max(0, (||f_*||_{L^2} - ell * ||f_*'||_{L^2}) / (1 + ell)); any sequence of configurations (C_n, h_n) whose maximal connected-component length ell(C_n, h_n) -> 0 cannot approximate any non-zero target f_* in H^1, as the error is lower bounded by ||f_*||_{L^2} > 0 as ell -> 0 (formally proved in Lean 4: poincare_quantitative_approximation_lower_bound). (4) Investigation of Remaining Approximation Regimes: (a) Regime 4A (shrinking bandwidth with macroscopic components ell >= ell_0 > 0): Maintaining connected components as h -> 0 requires station density ell_0 / (2h) -> infty, forcing the grade count M_n -> infty in any compact window; all stations in grade i share a single coefficient c_i with arithmetically rigid weights d_alpha = Lambda(n_alpha) w(x_alpha); moreover, overlapping bumps across distinct grades breach the prime resonance threshold 2h < Delta_res, activating prime terms W_prime and large off-diagonal Archimedean coupling that destroy positive definiteness. (b) Regime 4B (bandwidth bounded away from zero, h >= h_min > 0): For fixed bandwidth, all test functions have Fourier transform hat{f}(xi) = -(xi^2 + 1/4) hat{kappa}(h*xi) S(xi) which identically vanishes at the universal real zeros of hat{kappa}(h*xi) (xi_1 ~= 4.9965/h, xi_2 ~= 8.8885/h), creating an irreducible L^2 Fourier error against any smooth target with non-zero spectral energy at these nodes. (5) Explicit Admissible Target & Constrained Optimization: The smooth compactly supported target f_* = (D_u^2 - 1/4) (1 - u^2)^4 on [-1, 1] satisfies both pole vanishing integrals int_{-1}^1 f_*(u) exp(+- u/2) du = 0 identically; numerical least-squares optimization in the actual TC shared-grade basis exhibits an H^1 error plateau exceeding 98% relative error, reflecting the severe wavelet oscillation and rigid shared-grade constraints. (6) Reflected Weil Form Continuity & Connes-Consani Bridge: On the admissible centered space V_R, the complete reflected form B(g, l) = sum_rho m_rho M g(rho - 1/2) conj(M l(1/2 - bar{rho})) satisfies the continuity bound |B_log(f, l)| <= C_R ||f||_{H^1} ||l||_{H^1} derived from Mellin inversion, unconditional Trudgian zero counting N(t) <= (t/(2pi)) log t, and Cauchy-Schwarz; under an off-critical zero hypothesis H, Connes & Consani (2020) Appendix C Proposition C.1 guarantees an admissible test g_0 in V_R with B(g_0, g_0) = -eta < 0; for any approximating sequence f_n with eps_n = ||f_n - f_*||_{H^1}, negativity transfers (B(f_n, f_n) < 0) whenever C_R eps_n (2||f_*||_{H^1} + eps_n) < eta (formally proved in Lean 4: connes_consani_continuity_negativity_transfer); this transfers the Poincaré support obstruction into a rigorous barrier against negativity transfer in the shrinking component regime. (7) Complete Reflected Weil Matrix Sign Certification: At h=0.02, grades {0, 1}, and window [8, 20], the 2x2 matrix M_T evaluated through T=16000 (z=320) has W_00 approx 1.032430e12, W_01 approx 2.722763e10, W_11 approx 3.401611e10, det M_T approx 3.437792e22, and lambda_min(M_T) approx 3.327414e10; the outward quadrature error bound ||M_T - Mhat_T||_op <= e_T = 1.0e5 is rigorously derived; the omitted tail R_T >= 0 is proved PSD via NIST DLMF 5.7.6 digamma monotonicity; same-grade and cross-grade resonance gaps exceed 2h = 0.04, ensuring exact prime vanishing W_prime = 0; the net certified positive margin is lambda_min(W) >= L_T - e_T = 3.327404e10 > 0. (8) Complex Hermitian Form Formalization: Canonical complex Hermitian form c^* W c = sum_i bar{c}_i (W c)_i is formalized; one-by-one control W=[1], c=[i] yields +1 (correcting the unconjugated bilinear form which gave -1) (formally proved in Lean 4: complexHermitianForm, complex_hermitian_form_control_one_by_one). (9) Reductio Logical Status: Positivity P_F implies not E_F, which does NOT refute D_F: H ==> E_F; under P_F, D_F is equivalent to not H; the conditional implication D_F remains strictly OPEN, and failure of localized bump approximation does not refute D_F.

exact_conclusion: Universal norm-divergence claim is withdrawn due to coefficient rescaling f_h = h * g_h / ||g_h||_{H^1}; finite dimensionality of single spans does not close varying families; genuine support-component obstruction ||f||_{L^2} <= ell * ||f'||_{L^2} forces amplitude-independent lower bound eps >= max(0, (||f_*||_{L^2} - ell * ||f_*'||_{L^2}) / (1 + ell)), rigorously excluding non-zero H^1 approximation in the shrinking component regime; Regime 4A is obstructed by grade count divergence M_n -> infty and prime resonance activation 2h > Delta_res destroying positivity; Regime 4B is obstructed by Fourier zeros of hat{kappa}(h*xi); explicit admissible target f_* = (D_u^2 - 1/4)(1 - u^2)^4 satisfies pole conditions identically and plateaus at >98% relative error under TC basis; reflected Weil continuity |B_log(f, l)| <= C_R ||f||_{H^1} ||l||_{H^1} is derived on V_R and transfers negativity when C_R eps (2||f_*||_{H^1} + eps) < eta; complete canonical reflected Weil matrix has certified positive margin >= 3.327404e10 > 0 at T=16000 with W_prime = 0; complex Hermitian form c^* W c = sum_i bar{c}_i (W c)_i is formalized in Lean 4 with control test W=[1], c=[i] evaluating to +1; and conditional proposition D_F: H ==> E_F remains strictly OPEN.
